production.direction_en: A stairway descends through the mountain into the altar. Seven chains cross the passage; each bears the seven-notched gray seal that Yseldra left on Mahmut's shield. Nixie returns with Jori and Odelia.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch7_altar (uneasy layer), chains as percussion | post: bgm_ledger_motif (seven notes, then silence where the eighth should be)

commands.speaker: nixie_vale
commands.text: I brought the people from Oakhaven as far as the lower pass. They are safe. I am not staying behind again.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: These links came from my family's forge. We were told they were made for a royal bridge.

commands.speaker: odelia_pike
commands.text: They were made to hold something in place. The question is what the crown was afraid would move.

commands.speaker: nixie_vale
commands.text: The chain-bearers up there sing to it. They think the eclipse is holding its breath for the kingdom.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: We find the answer together. No one goes ahead alone.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: You say that as if I am the one who keeps trying to disappear.
